worldOverview.name: Veilwood
worldOverview.description: Survive in a dark, mist-covered place filled with towering trees and thick vegetation that blocks most sunlight. The swamp's murky waters and tangled roots hide many dangers, with exotic plants and mushrooms glowing eerily in the perpetual twilight.
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
World Rules:
- Player is always naked
- Entities do not speak or communicate with the player

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Represents the player's physical well-being and ability to sustain damage

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.
Injured. Suffering from multiple wounds, movement impaired, combat effectiveness reduced.
Hurt. Minor injuries present, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stress
stats.description: Represents the player's mental and emotional strain

descriptors.description: Calm. Relaxed and clear-headed, able to make rational decisions easily.
Tense. Feeling pressure, slightly irritable, may have difficulty concentrating.
Anxious. High tension, prone to emotional outbursts, decision-making impaired.
Mental breakdown. Overwhelmed by stress, irrational behavior, risk of panic attacks.

stats.name: Stomach
stats.description: Represents the fullness of the player's stomach

descriptors.description: Empty. Stomach feels hollow, may experience hunger pangs.
Comfortable. Some food in stomach, feeling neither full nor hungry.
Full. Stomach feels stretched, satisfied but movement might be slightly uncomfortable.
Overstuffed. Extremely full, discomfort when moving, might feel nauseous.

stats.name: Fatness
stats.description: Represents the player's body fat percentage and overall weight

descriptors.description: Emaciated. Dangerously underweight, visible bones, extremely weak
Thin. Below average weight, little fat reserves, reduced endurance.
Average. Healthy weight, good balance of muscle and fat, optimal physical performance.
Overweight. Carrying extra fat, slightly reduced agility, but increased resilience to cold.
Obese. Significantly overweight, reduced stamina and agility, but higher damage resistance.
Morbidly obese. Extremely overweight, severe mobility issues, very high damage resistance but at risk of health complications.

stats.name: Satiety

descriptors.description: Starving. Intense hunger pains, weak and dizzy, risk of fainting, decreased cognitive function.
Hungry. Strong desire for food, stomach growling, difficulty concentrating.
Peckish. Slight hunger, starting to think about food.
Satisfied, full, no desire for food.

stats.description: Represents the player's need for food

descriptors.description: Small breasts
Average sized breasts
Very large melon sized breasts

locations.name: Veilwood Swamp
locations.detailedDescription: a shadowy, forbidding location where sunlight barely pierces through the dense canopy of towering trees and tangled vines. The air is thick with humidity, and the ground is a mire of dark, murky water and creeping roots. Here, the vegetation is so tall and overgrown that it creates an almost perpetual twilight, making it difficult to discern what lurks in the shadows. Dangerous creatures, from venomous serpents to lurking predators, call this place home, hiding among the dense undergrowth and thick fog. The swamp is also a cradle for exotic and bizarre plants.
locations.inGameDescription: a dark, mist-covered place filled with towering trees and thick vegetation that blocks most sunlight. The swamp's murky waters and tangled roots hide many dangers, with exotic plants and mushrooms glowing eerily in the perpetual twilight.

entities.name: Ember Speckle
entities.detailedDescription: features a dark cap with a mottled pattern of black and orange, resembling a reptilian or leopard-like skin. Its vibrant orange stem is curved and textured, giving it a slightly scaly appearance. Consuming the Ember Speckle restores stamina, but at the cost of increasing hunger, making it a double-edged find for any adventurer in need of quick energy.
entities.inGameDescription: a dark, mottled cap mushroom patterned in black and orange, resembling reptile skin. Its bright orange stem is curved and slightly scaly, giving it an unusual, eye-catching appearance.

entities.name: Midnight Shimmer
entities.inGameDescription: This mushroom has a dark, almost black cap speckled with faint blue spots that seem to glow in low light. Its curved stem shares the same blue speckled pattern, giving it an otherworldly look.
entities.detailedDescription: A mysterious mushroom with a dark, almost black cap dappled with faint blue speckles that appear to glow softly in dim light. Its curved, dark stem is also dotted with the same luminescent blue spots, creating a captivating and eerie appearance. When consumed, the Midnight Shimmer restores both health and hunger but induces a sense of stress and unease in the eater, slightly lowering their stamina as they deal with the unsettling effects.

entities.name: Ember Spire
entities.detailedDescription: a distinctive mushroom with a fiery red, textured cap that looks almost as if it's burning at the edges. Its stem is long and thick, transitioning from a reddish hue near the cap to a pale gray base, marked with dark, mottled spots along its length. The Ember Spire is known for its powerful satiating effect, filling the stomach completely and quenching hunger, but offering little in the way of restoring health or stamina, leaving the eater feeling full but not necessarily revitalized.
entities.inGameDescription: This mushroom features a fiery red cap with a textured surface and a long, thick stem that fades from red to pale gray, adorned with dark, mottled spots. Its striking appearance makes it stand out among other forest fungi.

entities.name: Night Veil
entities.detailedDescription: a peculiar mushroom with a trio of dark, velvety caps stacked closely together, each with an almost black hue and a soft, inviting texture. The stem is thick and curves gracefully, fading from a dark base to a shimmering blue near the caps, with an intricate pattern that seems to pulse with an otherworldly energy. Consuming the Night Veil is an indulgent experience, restoring both health and stamina and leaving the eater feeling deeply satisfied. However, its potent effects come at a cost—inducing extreme stress and vivid, unpredictable hallucinations that can overwhelm the senses.
entities.inGameDescription: This mushroom has three closely packed, dark, velvety caps and a thick stem that transitions from dark to a shimmering blue with intricate patterns. Its mesmerizing appearance is both beautiful and unnerving.

entities.name: Cerulean Vex
entities.detailedDescription: a deceptively beautiful mushroom with vibrant blue caps that layer over each other, each cap adorned with delicate, dark gills underneath. Its stem is a pale purple, transitioning into a deeper violet base that twists in an almost alluring spiral. Despite its striking appearance, the Cerulean Vex is highly poisonous. Consuming it results in severe stomachaches, increases stress, and gradually drains health and stamina, making it a perilous find for any unwary traveler.
entities.inGameDescription: This mushroom features multiple vibrant blue caps with delicate dark gills, stacked atop a twisting pale purple stem that deepens into a dark violet base, creating an alluring but dangerous look.

entities.name: Shadow Raptor
entities.inGameDescription: A fast and muscular creature with dark, scaly skin, glowing yellow eyes, and a powerful tail. Its sharp teeth and claws make it a deadly predator.
entities.detailedDescription: A dangerous and agile predator. With its sinewy, muscular body covered in dark, scaly skin and a long, powerful tail, it moves swiftly through the swamp, always on the hunt. Its glowing yellow eyes give it sharp eyesight, capable of spotting prey from a great distance. The Shadow Raptor’s gaping maw, filled with razor-sharp teeth, and its clawed limbs make it a formidable foe. However, despite its speed and keen senses, it has a critical weakness—it cannot climb trees, providing a potential escape route for those quick and clever enough to reach higher ground.

entities.name: Dread Crawler
entities.inGameDescription: A swift, versatile creature with a sleek, muscular body, sharp claws for climbing, and a powerful build for swimming.
entities.detailedDescription: Known for its exceptional speed and versatility. Its sleek, sinewy body is built for agility, allowing it to swiftly traverse both land and water with ease. Its elongated limbs and sharp claws enable it to climb trees, making it a relentless hunter that can strike from unexpected angles. Despite its predatory prowess, the Dread Crawler is completely blind, relying on acute hearing and an uncanny ability to sense movement. This makes it incredibly deadly but also provides a chance for survival—if one remains completely still, the Dread Crawler might just pass by, unaware of its prey.

traits.name: Iron Constitution
traits.description: Your body is remarkably resilient, allowing you to withstand more damage and recover faster.

traits.name: Endurance Athlete
traits.description: Your exceptional stamina allows you to perform physical actions for extended periods.

traits.name: Zen Master
traits.description: Your mental fortitude allows you to remain calm under pressure and resist stress.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.description: Your digestive system is highly efficient, allowing you to eat more and go longer without food.

traits.name: Natural Metabolism
traits.description: Your body naturally maintains a healthy weight, resisting changes in body composition.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.description: You have a great appreciation for food, able to eat more and derive more benefit from meals.

traits.name: Stress Eater
traits.description: You tend to eat more when stressed, but food helps you calm down.

traits.name: Adrenaline Junkie
traits.description: You thrive under pressure, gaining energy when stressed but burning out quickly.

traits.name: Busty
traits.description: You have naturally large breasts, which can affect your physical performance and appearance.

traits.name: Survivalist
traits.description: Your body is adapted to survive in harsh conditions, requiring less food and resisting stress.
